purpose: Test one physically interpretable decoder representation change after the exhausted V15 noise-tail program, without post-hoc tuning or independent-data access.

e4_trilinear_decoder.single_change_from_v15_e3: replace nearest-neighbor interpolation by trilinear interpolation with align_corners=false at both decoder scale transitions of the observable-context residual U-Net
e4_trilinear_decoder.architecture_invariant: all learned layers, channel counts, skip connections, condition channels, context features, residual representation, and trainable parameter count remain identical to V15 E3
e4_trilinear_decoder.selection: smallest candidate passing all unchanged V6 field checks in all three development domains

report_only_all_band_diagnostic.quantity: generated total power divided by truth total power
report_only_all_band_diagnostic.prediction: relative to V15 E3 at the same checkpoint step, interpolation alone should leave every reported band approximately unchanged; this is a falsifiable diagnostic, not an extra acceptance threshold
report_only_all_band_diagnostic.seal_warning: Any passing candidate must disclose low-band ratios, including the V15 E3 SIMBA 0.3-1 ratio of 1.139, because these bands are outside the unchanged V6 power gate.

fixed_decision_order: implement and train E4 exactly as declared
evaluate candidates in ascending order 5000 then 10000 using the unchanged V6 field gate on all three development domains
if E4 passes, stop development and create a new one-file committed Astrid seal before any independent-data access
if E4 fails because TNG 0-1 Mpc/h two-point remains worse than deterministic, stop without opening Astrid and predeclare one band-balanced denoising-loss experiment
if E4 makes TNG pass and only Swift peak/void remains, stop without opening Astrid and predeclare one all-band target-free conditional-scale experiment
for any other E4 failure pattern, stop without opening Astrid and obtain a new independent design audit before another experiment

independent_audit.conclusion: V15 E3 improved the noise mismatch, but the remaining TNG sub-Mpc two-point error and Swift peak/void amplitude error are distinct; nearest-to-trilinear decoder interpolation is the least invasive eligible representation redesign.
